specificFindings: Literary exploration focus is not a universal experiment; Dedalus preference and author/work pairings are preserved without swapping roles or titles.
At key moments does not mean at all times, and uncertainty/freedom/self-expression preference directions remain correct.
Gopnik2015 essay date is distinct from recalled2006 age50 experience and later2007 sabbatical. Falling apart is a self-described crisis, not a new diagnosis.
Personal discovery is reported as her own narrative; then marks timing, not a proven causal origin of orientation.

Set in marks onset in a personal account; loss of scientist/mother roles is identity experience, not independently documented removal of academic credentials or children. No treatment recommendation is added.
Intellectual rabbit hole is metaphor, not physical excavation; historical quest to link Desideri1728 and Hume1738 is a research goal, not already proven direct contact.
La Fleche home to college is location. Had Desideri lived there is an open past question, not a statement or future command.
Looking forward to tomorrow is a change in this individual account, not a guaranteed depression cure; Desideri research is harder than Hume, not the reverse.
2007 Caltech sabbatical and later Rome archives are kept distinct. A temporal overlap at college does not itself establish that two men met.
Must have read is a strong past deduction in the book narrative, not a future obligation, permission or eyewitness transcript; no extra historical certainty is manufactured.
Eastern philosophy/Western Enlightenment connection is described within the book account; Enlightenment historical proper noun is distinguished from personal spiritual enlightenment.
Gopnik renewed happiness quote belongs to her article, and But not all broadens identity beyond happiness; solitude and sadness are not erased.
All was not lost permits renewal despite real crisis, not no losses or exact restoration of every former role.
Jobs is another exploration example. Smart but hated school retains coexistence, and garage activity is fixing/making with father, not later orchard work or school party light shows.
Questions8,12,20,22 include exact relevant context for identity, unresolved inquiry, broadening and partial-loss interpretation. Stable source wording and candidate boundaries stay unchanged.
limitations: This is a batch of ongoing whole-book work, not all gaps completed.
